name: fist-pms
description: See and update your FIST PMS issues from Claude: statuses, priorities, assignees, comments and new issues.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to FIST PMS (pms.fistinnovations.com) using your own PMS login. The first time you use it, a sign-in window opens (Microsoft Edge on Windows, Google Chrome on macOS); sign in there as usual. Your password never passes through Claude or this extension, and the saved session stays on your computer in ~/.fist-pms-dashboard.

tools.name: check_login
tools.description: Check the PMS sign-in, opening a sign-in window if needed

tools.name: list_my_issues
tools.description: List your issues, filtered by project, status, text or overdue

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Full details of an issue, including comments and sub-issues

tools.name: get_project_options
tools.description: Statuses, people and labels of a project

tools.name: update_status
tools.description: Move an issue to another status
